headline: Safaricom Dismisses 118 Staff for Fraud Amid Intensified Crackdown
summary: Safaricom dismissed 118 employees for fraud in the year to March, more than four times the 2021 level, even as overall fraud incidents dropped by 82% according to the company's sustainable business report.
why: Internal governance and fraud mitigation are key operational risk factors for major telecommunications operators handling high volumes of digital financial transactions.

impacts.name: Safaricom
impacts.why: Aggressive internal enforcement reduces long-term operational fraud risks despite short-term administrative disruptions.
